about: Clicks after an escape (`\$`, `\#`, `\_`), a soft hyphen and an emoji joiner, literal em and en dashes, and locale quotes with thin spaces (« ») land on the clicked character; a code block's tokens touch.

runs.t: Итог: «всё прошло хорошо» — и это главное.
Il a dit « bonjour les amis » puis partit.
A soft hy­phen and a fam👨‍👩‍👧ily emoji word.
Plain line with « quoted words » inside it.
